description:
Find a brand's Wikidata entity and return the URLs to use in Organization.sameAs (Wikidata, Wikipedia, X, LinkedIn, Crunchbase, GitHub, YouTube, Facebook, Instagram), its official site and its Google Knowledge Graph entity.

Billing: free — public APIs, no LLM tokens.

Matching is strict: found:true only when a candidate's Wikidata official website (P856) matches `domain` (matched_by:"domain") or you pin an entity with `qid` (matched_by:"qid"). Otherwise found:false with same_as:[] and `candidates` (qid, label, official_site, domain_matched, …) plus a `next_step`: keep the site's own resolving sameAs (site_same_as) and ask the user for the authoritative profiles it lacks. Never put a candidate's URLs in sameAs unless the user confirms it is their brand; then call again with its qid.

google_kg is the brand's Google Knowledge Graph entity, same rule: matched by `domain` (its website) or the Wikidata item's KG id, never by name. google_kg_status "not_confirmed" means no KG result could be tied to the brand, not that Google has no entity (sameAs listing the Wikidata item, and that item carrying the website and KG ID, make it provable). "unavailable": the lookup couldn't run; conclude nothing.

When to call: before writing Organization schema (wp_set_organization_schema), Article.publisher or Product.brand. Always pass domain.

Returns: { found, domain_matched, matched_by, wikidata_qid, label, description, official_site, same_as, detail: { wikipedia_url, twitter, linkedin, crunchbase, github, youtube, facebook, instagram, google_kg }, candidates, google_kg: { kg_id, name, types, description, url, domain_matched, wikidata_id_matched, … } | null, google_kg_status: matched|not_confirmed|unavailable, site_same_as?: [{url, resolves, status}], next_step? }. site_same_as: the sameAs URLs the site's homepage JSON-LD declares, each checked live (the owner's own claim: resolving ones are safe to keep). A pinned qid whose site doesn't match domain gives domain_matched:false and a next_step to confirm with the user.

domain.description: The brand's homepage domain (e.g. moz.com). Needed for found:true unless qid is given.

qid.description: Pin a Wikidata item the user confirmed is their brand, e.g. Q48818116.

name: discover_brand_entities
title: Look up a brand's authoritative entity record on Wikidata and Google's Knowledge Graph
